name: Bulwark
description: A shield for everything you publish. Every request is decoded and judged in microseconds by an attack engine with 22 categories and 91 known CVE exploits that reads every header, scored CRS-style with per-address behaviour, and checked against 250k+ blocklisted addresses; attackers are banned on every tunnel at once. Its own dashboard shows every request in full, warns about waves, graphs the patterns, inspects any IP across a dozen free sources and reports attackers to the vendors that missed them. With the selfmail addon, it emails you about waves too.
author: Alexd Aero

update_card.title: {name} {version}
update_card.tagline: A new attack engine: catches 90% of attacks it was never tuned for (1.9: 67%), nearly twice as fast, drops no ordinary traffic.
highlights: Reads headers too: smuggling, Log4Shell, cookies, Next.js bypass, default passwords
SSRF in every spelling, NoSQL/LDAP, code in 5 languages, obfuscated shell, open redirects
Secret hunts for AI-agent configs, cloud keys and CI files; 91 CVE exploits, up from 44
A clearer IP Inspector: who says what, at a glance
Vendor reports work: blocklist.de too, and nothing is lost before you add a key

actions.label: Stop
actions.confirm: The dashboard, lookups, waves and reports stop. The guard inside Burrow keeps enforcing bans and blocklists on its own.
